Sets which layer a body is in and which layers it collides with. Two bodies collide only if each one has the layer of the other in its mask. Bodies are in layer 0 and collide with all layers by default.

The mask has a bit for each of the 64 layers, split into two numbers of 32 bits: bit n of `mask_low` is layer n, bit n of `mask_high` is layer 32 + n. -1 sets all bits.

```blitzbasic
; Ghosts (layer 1) pass through walls (layer 2) but not through each other.
PhysicsLayer ghost, 1, ~(1 Shl 2), -1
PhysicsLayer wall, 2, -1, -1
```
@param entity The body.
@param layer 0 to 63.
@param mask_low Layers 0 to 31 that it collides with.
@param mask_high Layers 32 to 63 that it collides with.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
